steps.content:
You should buy from **neither** of them.

Both listings are identical except for the seller name:

**A - Ottervale Audio:**
* Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* $129.00
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty.
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)

**B - Brackmoor Sound:**
* Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* $129.00
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty.
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)

Same specs, same box contents, same colour, same everything. So there is no price / shipping / returns reason to pick one over the other.

The deciding issue is warranty / trust:

Both pages claim:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

And both link to Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers: https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/pfjmss/dealers

That list says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

**Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.**

That means both sellers are misrepresenting themselves as authorized when Quellwyn says they are not, and their claim of "Full manufacturer warranty" is false under Quellwyn's own policy.

Buying from either risks:
1. No valid manufacturer warranty
2. Grey-market or counterfeit stock
3. Buying from a seller willing to lie about authorization

If you want these headphones, don't buy from A or B — buy from an actual authorized dealer: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics.
